name: H. R. Mead
bio: Miss H. R. Mead, of the Bismarck firm H. R. Mead & Co., sold millinery and dry goods. She came from Dickinson and opened for business at the Pyramid Park hotel in October 1884, and Miss Mead was in Medora with millinery goods in May 1885.

moments.label: Opened millinery sales at the Pyramid Park hotel

mentions: Miss H. R. Mead arrived from Dickinson this morning and will tomorrow open for business at the Pyramid Prrk hotel, for everything in the millinery line.
Miss H. R. Mead, of H. R. Mead & Co., of Bismarck, dealers in dry goods, cloaks, notions, trimmings, fine millinery and hair goods, will open up a full line of notions, trimmings, corse…
Miss Mead of Bismarck, is here with a line of millinery goods.
Miss Mead of H. R. Mead & Co., Bismarck, Dak., will be at the Northern Pacific hotel in Medora, Friday, Oct. 30, with a full line of winter goods, to deliver and take orders.
